books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.blurb: Tiny changes, remarkable results: how habits form, how identity drives them, and how to build good ones and break bad ones.

lessons.b: Small improvements compound into large results.
Lasting habits come from changing who you are, not chasing outcomes.
How habits form, and how to build them.

lessons.t: You can’t change what you can’t see
lessons.b: Before you change a habit, you have to notice it.

lessons.t: The best way to start a new habit
lessons.b: Give every habit a time and a place.
Change what you see, and you change what you do.
The most self-controlled people are the least tempted.

lessons.t: How to make a habit irresistible
lessons.b: The second law: make it attractive.

lessons.t: How family and friends shape your habits
lessons.b: We copy the habits of the people around us.

lessons.t: Find and fix the causes of your bad habits
lessons.b: Every craving hides a deeper motive.
